messages:
mona: Quick loop on the dataset table — noticed on narrow widths the row action buttons (Edit / More) collapse into a single icon but the hit target overlaps the row hover area. Also the success toast appears and briefly covers the action icon making it hard to tap. Attached small screencap.

ev an: repro'd. Happens at <= 360px. The kebab gets `position: absolute` which shifts z-index.

harper: For consistency with other lists, maybe move the primary inline action into the row header and keep the kebab for secondary actions. That way we avoid multiple layers. Could adjust spacing tokens to `space-1` for the header area to fit.

mona: Header action makes sense. Concern: on very dense tables we still need clear affordance for focus. We should use the compact button token but keep the focus ring at 3px.

ria: Accessibility note: when actions collapse, ensure the DOM order keeps visible action before the kebab so tab order feels natural. If we move visually but not in DOM, keyboard users get confused. Also set `aria-expanded` on the row if it toggles.

ev an: Implementation idea:
```
/* keep DOM order, visually move */
.row-actions { display: flex; }
.row-actions .primary { order: -1; }
.kebab { order: 1; }
```
This keeps tab order matching DOM (primary first) but renders primary on left when space allows.

harper: Nice. For toasts: instead of bottom anchor, use stacking rules: if an interactive overlay (modal, popover, or row-skeleton) is present, move toast to top-right of viewport. That prevents overlap on small screens. We'll need design token `toast-anchor` variants: `bottom`, `top-right`, `inline`.

mona: Microcopy nit: success toast currently "Saved." For rows use "Row updated" or "Changes saved" depending on action. Keep to 2-3 words. Also error toast should say "Update failedTry again."

ria: Screen reader behavior: use `role=status` and `aria-live=polite` for success toasts, `role=alert` for errors. Avoid focusing the toast. Also when primary action triggers a nav to details, move focus into the detail view with a logical heading.

ev an: Dev checklist I can take: 1) reorder via CSS `order` trick, 2) compact token space-1 for header, 3) toast anchor switch when `data-overlay` present, 4) microcopy options update. Will throw PR soon.

harper: Design acceptance criteria: keyboard tab lands on visible primary action, no toasts cover actionable controls, focus ring remains visible at compact density, and microcopy chosen from provided options.

mona: I'll update the component spec in Figma and add token variants. Options for copy: ["Saved", "Changes saved", "Row updated"]. I'll mark preferred as "Changes saved".

ev an: PR link when ready plz. I'll flag behind a feature flag `responsive-action-reflow`.

design-bot: Reminder: the weekly design review is tomorrow 2pm — drop before/after screenshots in the PR for review.

mona: Thanks everyone. I'll attach Figma frames and label the token change as `space-1` -> `row-header-padding`. Marking this thread blocked until PR lands. :spiral_note_pad:
